records.source: It's too dangerous without a sword. But I like your sense of adventure.$h
records.translation: Masyadong mapanganib kung walang espada. Pero gusto ko ang hilig mo sa pakikipagsapalaran.$h

records.source: Great.$8
records.translation: Ayos.$8

records.source: Okay... Never mind then.$9
records.translation: Sige... Huwag na pala.$9

records.source: Don't worry, I'll make sure to show you the ropes before I let you do anything dangerous.$8^There's no need to worry... I'll make sure you're safe.$8
records.translation: Huwag mag-alala, titiyakin kong ituro muna sa iyo ang dapat gawin bago kita hayaang gumawa ng anumang mapanganib.$8^Hindi mo kailangang mag-alala... Titiyakin kong ligtas ka.$8

records.source: Hmm... Not exactly how I'd put it but, yeah.
records.translation: Hmm... Hindi ganyan mismo ang pagkakasabi ko, pero oo.

records.source: Yea... That's exactly how I feel, too.$l
records.translation: Oo... Ganiyan din mismo ang nararamdaman ko.$l

records.source: Oh... Well maybe this wasn't the right place to bring you, then. I thought you'd see the beauty in it.$s
records.translation: Ah... Kung gayon, baka hindi ito ang tamang lugar na pagdalhan sa iyo. Akala ko ay makikita mo ang kagandahan nito.$s

records.source: Ugh... You sound like my Mom.$a#$b#...*sigh*$s#$b#You're right, though. I'm addicted to these things, it's not good.$s
records.translation: Ugh... Para kang si Nanay magsalita.$a#$b#...*buntong-hininga*$s#$b#Pero tama ka. Lulong ako sa mga ito at hindi iyon mabuti.$s

records.source: Everyone is so happy in the sun. I don't get it.
records.translation: Napakasaya ng lahat sa sikat ng araw. Hindi ko maunawaan.

records.source: Everyone is so happy when it's sunny out...#$e#Different people like different things, I guess.||Most people like the sun, huh?#$b#I guess you do need a minimum amount of vitamin D...
records.translation: Napakasaya ng lahat kapag maaraw...#$e#Siguro ay magkakaiba lang ang gusto ng mga tao.||Gusto ng karamihan ang araw, ano?#$b#Siguro ay kailangan mo rin ng pinakamababang dami ng bitamina D...

records.source: I'm looking forward to the cold, damp season. I feel more at home.
records.translation: Inaasam ko ang malamig at mahalumigmig na panahon. Mas panatag ang pakiramdam ko roon.

records.source: I'm looking forward to the cold, damp season. Channeling my inner toad, I guess.$h
records.translation: Inaasam ko ang malamig at mahalumigmig na panahon. Siguro ay inilalabas ko ang palakang nasa loob ko.$h

records.source: What's the point of going outside? I've already seen it all.
records.translation: Ano ang saysay ng paglabas? Nakita ko na ang lahat.

records.source: If you're depressed, everything seems stupid. But if you're feeling positive, then even the most mundane things will make you happy.#$e#How do you stay positive long term? I have no idea.#$e#...Maybe I'll figure it out some day.
records.translation: Kapag nalulumbay ka, parang hangal ang lahat. Pero kapag positibo ang pakiramdam mo, kahit ang pinakakaraniwang bagay ay magpapasaya sa iyo.#$e#Paano ka mananatiling positibo sa mahabang panahon? Hindi ko alam.#$e#...Baka malaman ko rin balang araw.

records.source: Why am I grinning? I guess I've been unusually happy lately...$l
records.translation: Bakit ako nakangisi? Siguro ay mas masaya ako kaysa karaniwan nitong huli...$l

records.source: I definitely don't want to go swimming, if that's what you're going to ask.$s#$e#Oh, you just stopped to say hi? Sorry.
records.translation: Tiyak na ayaw kong lumangoy, kung iyan ang itatanong mo.$s#$e#Ah, dumaan ka lang upang bumati? Paumanhin.

records.source: If you ever wanted to go swimming... I guess I'd do it.$l
records.translation: Kung gusto mo mang lumangoy... Siguro ay sasama ako.$l

records.source: #$c .5#The temperature only starts to get comfortable at night.#$e#It always seems to stay a little cooler by the lake.
records.translation: #$c .5#Sa gabi lang nagsisimulang maging komportable ang temperatura.#$e#Parang laging medyo mas malamig sa tabi ng lawa.

records.source: Oh, hey. *yawn*... sorry.
records.translation: Ah, hoy. *hikab*... paumanhin.

records.source: Hey, I'm glad you stopped by.$h#$e#How have you been coping with this heat?
records.translation: Hoy, natutuwa akong dumaan ka rito.$h#$e#Paano mo kinakaya ang init na ito?

records.source: I hope we're not having mushroom casserole tonight...$s||Oh no, is it cave carrot tacos night? ...*groan*$s
records.translation: Sana ay hindi kaserol na kabute ang hapunan natin...$s||Naku, gabi ba ngayon ng mga taco ng Karot sa Yungib? ...*daing*$s

records.source: I'm not too big on festivals. Lots of commotion, too much social interaction... More stress than fun, if you ask me.
records.translation: Hindi ko gaanong gusto ang mga pista. Napakaraming ingay, labis na pakikisalamuha... Mas nakababahala kaysa masaya, kung ako ang tatanungin.

records.source: Ugh... Tomorrow is the worst festival of the year by a mile. Just wait and see how stupid I look during the flower dance.
records.translation: Ugh... Bukas ang di-hamak na pinakamasamang pista ng taon. Hintayin mo lang at makikita mo kung gaano ako kamukhang hangal sa Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak.

records.source: Are you looking forward to the Spirit's Eve festival? It's probably my favorite.$h
records.translation: Inaasam mo ba ang Bisperas ng mga Espiritu? Siguro ay iyon ang paborito ko.$h

records.source: The Spirit's Eve festival is tomorrow. I really hope they have those skeletons on display again this year.$h#$e#I almost feel like they're my friends at this point.
records.translation: Bukas ang Bisperas ng mga Espiritu. Sana talaga ay itanghal ulit nila ang mga kalansay ngayong taon.$h#$e#Parang mga kaibigan ko na sila sa puntong ito.

records.source: Hehe... It might be funny to put something disgusting in the potluck soup tomorrow. Just don't poison anyone.#$e#Why ruin the potluck? Hmm... I guess some people feel liberated when the rigid structures of society break down a little. Maybe I'm weird.
records.translation: Hehe... Baka nakakatawang maglagay ng isang bagay na nakakadiri sa sopas para sa salu-salo bukas. Huwag mo lang lasunin ang sinuman.#$e#Bakit sisirain ang salu-salo? Hmm... Siguro ay nakadarama ng paglaya ang ilang tao kapag bahagyang gumuguho ang mahigpit na kaayusan ng lipunan. Baka kakaiba ako.

records.source: Tomorrow we'll all be gathering at the docks to see the migration of the moonlight jellies. I think it starts at ten o'clock.
records.translation: Bukas ay magtitipon tayong lahat sa mga pantalan upang makita ang paglipat ng mga Dikyang Sinag-Buwan. Sa tingin ko'y magsisimula iyon nang alas-diyes.

records.source: It's the eve of the winter star today. Better make sure you've got an empty stomach for the feast tomorrow.
records.translation: Bisperas ngayon ng Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig. Tiyakin mong walang laman ang tiyan mo para sa piging bukas.

records.source: I usually only go outside after dark. Does that sound weird to you?
records.translation: Karaniwan ay lumalabas lang ako kapag madilim na. Kakaiba ba iyon para sa iyo?

records.source: Last night, I saw a group of bats flying around near the lake.#$e#I guess maybe they are feeding on the mosquitoes this time of year?
records.translation: Kagabi ay nakakita ako ng isang pangkat ng mga paniking lumilipad malapit sa lawa.#$e#Siguro ay kinakain nila ang mga lamok sa ganitong panahon ng taon?

records.source: So... it's the big harvest season, isn't it?
records.translation: Aba... panahon na ng malaking anihan, hindi ba?

records.source: You're probably making a lot of money on your farm, huh?#$e#I guess I should get a job soon...$s
records.translation: Malamang ay kumikita ka nang malaki sa bukid mo, ano?#$e#Siguro ay dapat na rin akong maghanap ng trabaho...$s

records.source: Pumpkin spice this... pumpkin spice that... man, I do get sick of these seasonal fads.
records.translation: Timplang kalabasa rito... timplang kalabasa roon... naku, talagang nagsasawa ako sa mga pana-panahong uso na ito.

records.source: Who does Demetrius think he is, telling me what to do? He's not even my real father.$a
records.translation: Sino ba si Demetrius sa palagay niya para utusan ako? Hindi ko nga siya tunay na ama.$a

records.source: I've always felt like an underdog. But the challenge will just make me stronger.
records.translation: Lagi kong naramdamang ako ang minamaliit. Pero lalo lang akong palalakasin ng hamon.

records.source: *yawn*... what time is it? I think I slept too much last night.
records.translation: *hikab*... anong oras na? Sa tingin ko'y sumobra ang tulog ko kagabi.

records.source: I'm glad you showed up. I was starting to get bored.#$e#Now I feel a lot more energetic, believe it or not.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong dumating ka. Nagsisimula na akong mabagot.#$e#Mas masigla na ang pakiramdam ko ngayon, maniwala ka man o hindi.

records.source: My room might be a little less depressing if I had a window...$s
records.translation: Baka hindi gaanong nakapanlulumo ang kuwarto ko kung may bintana ito...$s

records.source: *yawn*... I was up until 3 reading this new book...#$q 62/63 fall_Fri_old#Do you read, @?#$r 62 -30 Fri_bad#Yep. The classics.#$r 63 30 Fri_good#Only Sci-fi and Fantasy#$r 62 0 Fri_bad#I like a good Romance#$r 63 -30 Fri_bad#No, I don't read books
records.translation: *hikab*... Gising ako hanggang alas-tres sa pagbabasa ng bagong aklat na ito...#$q 62/63 fall_Fri_old#Nagbabasa ka ba, @?#$r 62 -30 Fri_bad#Oo. Ang mga klasiko.#$r 63 30 Fri_good#Kathang Agham at Pantasya lang#$r 62 0 Fri_bad#Gusto ko ng magandang romansa#$r 63 -30 Fri_bad#Hindi, hindi ako nagbabasa ng mga aklat

records.source: $p 62#You probably wouldn't like it.$s|I think you'd like it.
records.translation: $p 62#Malamang ay hindi mo iyon magugustuhan.$s|Sa tingin ko'y magugustuhan mo iyon.

records.source: Hey, me too. There's nothing like a good fiction to push the boundaries of the imagination.$h
records.translation: Hoy, ako rin. Walang katulad ang magandang kathang-isip upang lampasan ang mga hangganan ng imahinasyon.$h

records.source: Huh. Sounds boring.
records.translation: Huh. Mukhang nakababagot.

records.source: I've been reading a book about a farmer. Reminds me a lot of you, actually.$h#$e#Sorry if that creeps you out.$h
records.translation: Nagbabasa ako ng aklat tungkol sa isang magsasaka. Sa totoo lang, ipinaaalala niya sa akin ang tungkol sa iyo.$h#$e#Paumanhin kung kinikilabutan ka roon.$h

records.source: I was *this* close to moping in bed the entire day. Kinda wish I had, now.
records.translation: Kaunti na lang at nagmukmok ako sa kama nang buong araw. Sana pala ay itinuloy ko.

records.source: The sun is coming out less and less these days... wonderful.
records.translation: Paunti nang paunti ang pagsikat ng araw nitong mga araw... kahanga-hanga.

records.source: I'm enjoying this gloomy weather... although I have to say, it's a little cold.
records.translation: Nasisiyahan ako sa mapanglaw na panahong ito... pero aaminin ko, medyo malamig.

records.source: Nothing surprises me anymore... nothing makes me laugh.#$e#Yeah, I know... I'm being a little dramatic.
records.translation: Wala nang nakagugulat sa akin... wala nang nagpapatawa sa akin.#$e#Oo, alam ko... Medyo madrama ako.

records.source: Do you ever think back on your old self with shame and embarrassment?#$e#I guess it's just part of growing up.
records.translation: Binabalikan mo ba kung minsan ang dati mong sarili nang may pagkapahiya at pagkailang?#$e#Siguro ay bahagi lang iyon ng paglaki.

records.source: Hmm... I don't really have anything to say. I still don't know you very well.
records.translation: Hmm... Wala talaga akong masabi. Hindi pa rin kita gaanong kilala.

records.source: Hey...#$b#It's hard to think of new things to talk about, sometimes. Even after you know someone.#$e#...Sorry.
records.translation: Hoy...#$b#Mahirap mag-isip kung minsan ng mga bagong pag-uusapan. Kahit kakilala mo na ang isang tao.#$e#...Paumanhin.

records.source: I was so close to screaming at Mom for throwing away my old comic collection... But something stopped me.#$e#Hmm... with age comes wisdom.
records.translation: Muntik ko nang sigawan si Nanay dahil itinapon niya ang luma kong koleksiyon ng komiks... Pero may pumigil sa akin.#$e#Hmm... dumarating ang karunungan kasabay ng edad.

records.source: You came here to see me?$l#$e#...$h
records.translation: Pumunta ka rito para makita ako?$l#$e#...$h

records.source: %Sebastian seems lost in thought...
records.translation: %Mukhang malalim ang iniisip ni Sebastian...

records.source: Hey, don't let me stop you from getting your work done.#$e#If you aren't busy I don't mind if you stick around.$h
records.translation: Hoy, huwag kang magpapigil sa akin sa pagtatapos ng trabaho mo.#$e#Kung hindi ka abala, ayos lang sa akin na manatili ka.$h

records.source: I wonder what's for dinner tonight... *grumble*$s
records.translation: Ano kaya ang hapunan ngayong gabi... *kalam ng sikmura*$s

records.source: I should learn how to cook. That would be useful.
records.translation: Dapat akong matutong magluto. Magiging kapaki-pakinabang iyon.

records.source: It's fun to live so close to the train tracks. It's a reminder that there's a big world out there.
records.translation: Masarap manirahan nang napakalapit sa riles ng tren. Paalala iyon na may isang malaking mundo sa labas.

records.source: When I was younger I'd run out to the railroad whenever I heard a train coming.#$e#Whatever happened to those days...? *sigh*$s
records.translation: Noong mas bata ako, tumatakbo ako patungo sa riles tuwing naririnig kong may paparating na tren.#$e#Ano na ang nangyari sa mga araw na iyon...? *buntong-hininga*$s

records.source: The frogs aren't very happy in winter.#$e#Poor little guys.$s||I wonder what the frogs do in winter? Do they just become frozen and then thaw out in spring?
records.translation: Hindi gaanong masaya ang mga palaka sa taglamig.#$e#Kawawang maliliit na nilalang.$s||Ano kaya ang ginagawa ng mga palaka sa taglamig? Nagyeyelo lang ba sila at pagkatapos ay muling natutunaw sa tagsibol?

records.source: I like winter but I do feel bad for all the cold animals out there.#$e#I guess they're used to it, though... like me.
records.translation: Gusto ko ang taglamig, pero naaawa ako sa lahat ng hayop na nilalamig sa labas.#$e#Siguro ay sanay naman sila roon... tulad ko.

records.source: I built a snowgoon but Demetrius made me get rid of it.#$e#What's his problem?$u
records.translation: Gumawa ako ng salbaheng taong-niyebe pero ipinatanggal iyon ni Demetrius.#$e#Ano ba ang problema niya?$u

records.source: I built a snowgoon but Demetrius made me get rid of it... yet Maru's cute little snowman goes unharmed!$a#$e#Ridiculous.
records.translation: Gumawa ako ng salbaheng taong-niyebe pero ipinatanggal iyon ni Demetrius... samantalang hindi niya ginagalaw ang nakatutuwang munting taong-niyebe ni Maru!$a#$e#Katawa-tawa.
